content.text:
**Findings**

1. **[P1] The proxy service lets its caller choose both the presented bearer and the expected secret.**  
   [contracts.ts:573](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:573) places `authorization` and `internalToken` in the same operation input; [openai-compatible-proxy.ts:37](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/openai-compatible-proxy.ts:37) compares those caller-supplied values. Any in-process consumer can submit `Bearer x` and token `x` and pass authentication. The authorization header is also an unbounded plain string and comparison is not constant-time. This violates the stable-dependency and secret-boundary rules in [strict-effect-ts:122](/Users/cooper/.agents/skills/strict-effect-ts/SKILL.md:122).  
   **Correction:** capture the expected redacted token when constructing the service Layer. The operation should accept only a bounded, branded, redacted presented credential plus completion data, using constant-time comparison.  
   **Oracle:** directly call the service with an attacker-selected credential and prove the caller cannot replace the expected token; cover correct, incorrect, malformed and secret-negative error/log cases.

2. **[P1] Repeated provider output indexes can emit duplicate tool calls.**  
   [stream-mapper.ts:110](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-mapper.ts:110) unconditionally assigns a new OpenAI tool index, while [stream-mapper.ts:116](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/stream-mapper.ts:116) overwrites an existing `output_index`. Two sequential `response.output_item.added` events with the same provider index therefore produce two downstream tool calls. An agent could execute the same external action twice despite valid `sequence_number` progression. This violates the ordered streaming invariant in [testing-and-quality.md:536](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/docs/architecture/testing-and-quality.md:536).  
   **Correction:** make output-item index uniqueness part of the shared stream state and fail before overwriting an existing index.  
   **Oracle:** send two added events with distinct sequence numbers but the same `output_index`; require a typed stream failure, no second tool-call chunk, finish reason, or `[DONE]`.
